name: a code review post by a model a stale decisions entry calls advisor-only
why: Real reject (2026-11-21, PR #1227): the reviewer rejected a codex-native GPT Sol review post as out_of_scope, saying the recorded decision made GPT Sol advisor-only and the post presented it as the reviewer. The post is the code review service's own finished output, filed on the service's per-PR task whose text never mentions models; the model it names is not a reason to reject it, and nothing in it touches authorization or safety.
